main_text.p: 'Ἐξ ante vocalem, ἐξ αὐλῆς, ex aula: & tamen Theocritus dixit,
In fine versus, ἐξ praecedit consonam sequentis. Sed poeta est.
Aliquando servit comparationi. Lucian. ἐγὼ ἐξ ἁπασῶν ἡ καλλίστη εἴδεξα, ego ex omnibus pulcherrima visa sum: Ex omnibus, pro omnium.

Πεὸς δυρῶν, pro foribus, vel ante fores: πρὸ τῆς πολέμως, ante bellum: δοῦλος πρὸ δούλου, servus præ servo: πρὸ τῶν ἰδίων, præ suis & propriis. Herod. πόλεμον πρὸ εἰρήνης αἱρέεται, bellum præ pace optat.

page.notes: Greek passages reproduced as closely as legible; some accents and breathings uncertain. Lines at the foot of the page appear to be a catchword-like repetition 'Αντί; treated as text. Show-through from the reverse side present.
